name: Frozen Waterfall
desc: A waterfall caught mid-plunge and frozen — bundled columns of blue-white ice hang the full height of a rock chasm, translucent englacial cores glowing at their hearts, specular glints sliding down the flutes and a thin live meltwater thread still working behind the ice into a dark plunge pool while spindrift blows across and frost drifts down; cold blue-ice overcast, low sun raking gold, a moonlit nocturne, an x-ray of the ice, or sumi ink.

energy.doc: how hard the light works — lit ice edges, glint brightness, inner glow

scale.doc: how tall and wide the cascade is — column height and width (rebuilds the falls)

density.doc: how many ice columns, glints, pool ripples and drifting particles

speed.doc: spindrift, glint, drip and snow rate

melt.doc: how much live meltwater and dripping shows through the ice vs a hard freeze

haze.doc: how thick the ice-fog haze is around the rock walls

hue.doc: palette hue shift off the default cold ice-blue

x.doc: the centre of the falls and which way the light rakes the columns

y.doc: the plunge-pool line — low y gives more pool, high y a taller cascade

style.doc: aesthetic: blueice = cold blue-white ice on an overcast day, teal englacial cores; goldlit = warm low sun raking, amber highlights, blue shade; nocturne = moonlit deep blue with faint inner glow; xray = translucent internal structure, cyan-white, no rock; ink = the cascade as tonal sumi dry-brush strokes

act.doc: multi-minute programme — a hard freeze, a thaw where trickle and drips grow over sections, or heavy spindrift blowing across the face

seed.doc: regenerates the ice columns, rock walls and drifting particles

alpha.doc: how far the world sits back behind the performers
